dialogues.jp: 登校時間が早いと、普段と違った面々に出会う。
dialogues.en: I was early for school today, for once.
dialogues.text: I was early for school today, for once.

dialogues.jp:
西側に住んでいる連中は、バスで通ってくるの
で、混雑を避けようと思うとこの時間になるら
しい。
dialogues.en:
With enough time on my hands, I decide to walk to school and
avoid the crowds on the bus.
dialogues.text:
With enough time on my hands, I decide to walk to school and
avoid the crowds on the bus.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん、おはよっす」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Asakura-kun!"
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Asakura-kun!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「やあ、ことり。おはよう」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Kotori. Good morning."
dialogues.text: "Hey, Kotori. Good morning."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「珍しいですね、この時間にここを歩いてるな
　んて」
dialogues.en:
"This is a pretty rare sight, seeing you here walking so
calmly at this time."
dialogues.text:
"This is a pretty rare sight, seeing you here walking so
calmly at this time."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうかな？　……まあ、そうかもしれないな」
dialogues.en: "Really? ...Well, if you say so."
dialogues.text: "Really? ...Well, if you say so."

dialogues.jp:
我が身を振り返ってみると、そう言われても仕
方がないような気はする。
dialogues.en:
I turned my head over my shoulder to answer her. It's not
surprising that she thinks that, I suppose.
dialogues.text:
I turned my head over my shoulder to answer her. It's not
surprising that she thinks that, I suppose.

dialogues.jp:
どれだけ早起きして、登校しても、遅刻大王の
汚名はそう簡単に晴れるものではない。
dialogues.en:
No matter how many times I'm early for school now, it won't
be easy to shake the title of "Lateness King" off my
reputation.
dialogues.text:
No matter how many times I'm early for school now, it won't
be easy to shake the title of "Lateness King" off my
reputation.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、私はお友達が待ってるんで、先に行
　きますね」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, my friends are waiting for me up ahead, so I'd make
a move."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, my friends are waiting for me up ahead, so I'd make
a move."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、またな」
dialogues.en: "Okay, see you later."
dialogues.text: "Okay, see you later."

dialogues.jp:
ことりは、終始爽やかな笑顔を振りまいており、
あの声と笑顔で、今日一日が素敵な日になるよ
うな気がするから不思議だ。
dialogues.en:
That Kotori, with her cheerful style, light voice and ready
smile... it's always enough to brighten up someone's day.
dialogues.text:
That Kotori, with her cheerful style, light voice and ready
smile... it's always enough to brighten up someone's day.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「珍しいな、朝倉。雨でも降らなきゃいいけど」
dialogues.en: "This is rare, Asakura. You're going to make it rain now."
dialogues.text: "This is rare, Asakura. You're going to make it rain now."

dialogues.jp: 後ろから、ポンと肩を叩かれる。
dialogues.en: A light punch on my shoulder followed the words.
dialogues.text: A light punch on my shoulder followed the words.

dialogues.jp:
「誰かと思えば、工藤かよ。朝っぱらからきつ
　いな」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, it's just you Kudou. As biting as ever even this early
in the morning, huh?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, it's just you Kudou. As biting as ever even this early
in the morning, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「珍しいのは、事実だろ」
dialogues.en: "It's the truth, this doesn't happen often at all."
dialogues.text: "It's the truth, this doesn't happen often at all."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「まあな」
dialogues.en: "Well, whatever."
dialogues.text: "Well, whatever."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、遅刻するよりマシだ」
dialogues.en: "Well, it won't do to be late anyway."
dialogues.text: "Well, it won't do to be late anyway."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ごもっとも」
dialogues.en: "Quite right."
dialogues.text: "Quite right."

dialogues.jp:
こうして工藤と一緒に登校するなんて、滅多に
ないような気がする。
dialogues.en:
We started walking towards the school, participating in
thoughtless morning chatter.
dialogues.text:
We started walking towards the school, participating in
thoughtless morning chatter.

dialogues.jp: なんだか新鮮な気がするなぁ。
dialogues.en: This is a pretty new experience for me...
dialogues.text: This is a pretty new experience for me...

dialogues.jp:
こう、朝の香りっつうか、なんつうか、いい匂
いがする。
dialogues.en:
Not to mention there's some oddly sweet smell in the morning
air...
dialogues.text:
Not to mention there's some oddly sweet smell in the morning
air...

dialogues.jp: 「お前のシャンプーの匂いか」
dialogues.en: "Your shampoo's scent is pretty strong."
dialogues.text: "Your shampoo's scent is pretty strong."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　匂うか？　悪いな。朝風呂に入ってき
　たせいだ」
dialogues.en:
"Hm? Scent? Sorry, must've been from the morning bath I
took."
dialogues.text:
"Hm? Scent? Sorry, must've been from the morning bath I
took."

dialogues.jp:
工藤は、自分の髪の毛を人差し指と親指で、ぐ
じぐじといじった。
dialogues.en:
Kudou ran his thumb and index finger through his hair a few
times.
dialogues.text:
Kudou ran his thumb and index finger through his hair a few
times.

dialogues.jp:
「まあ、いいんじゃないか？　音夢だって時々
　朝にシャワー浴びてることあるし」
dialogues.en:
"Well, it's okay I guess. Nemu always takes morning showers
as well."
dialogues.text:
"Well, it's okay I guess. Nemu always takes morning showers
as well."

dialogues.jp:
たとえが女の子じゃ、なんのフォローにもなら
ないな。
dialogues.en:
That's pretty typical of a girl, and I've never followed her
example.
dialogues.text:
That's pretty typical of a girl, and I've never followed her
example.

dialogues.jp:
でも、朝風呂に入る余裕があるってのは、なん
となくうらやましい。
dialogues.en:
But having enough time to linger around and enjoy a bath
makes me feel sort of envious.
dialogues.text:
But having enough time to linger around and enjoy a bath
makes me feel sort of envious.

dialogues.jp:
俺がそうするなら、もっと早く起きなければい
けないってことか。
dialogues.en: Maybe I should consider waking up earlier to do so...
dialogues.text: Maybe I should consider waking up earlier to do so...

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、おはようございます」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai*, Good morning."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai*, Good morning."

dialogues.jp: この透明感のある声は……、月城か。
dialogues.en: This transparent-like voice... it's Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text: This transparent-like voice... it's Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp: 「おはよう、月城」
dialogues.en: "Morning, Tsukishiro."
dialogues.text: "Morning, Tsukishiro."

dialogues.jp:
月城の方からあいさつをしてくれるなんて、珍
しいな。というより、嬉しい。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro actually saying something to me doesn't happen
very often... I'm glad she did, though.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro actually saying something to me doesn't happen
very often... I'm glad she did, though.

dialogues.jp:
──が、話を続けようとすると、既に月城は俺
のずっと前方を歩いていた。
dialogues.en:
--Then, before I could even continue the "conversation",
Tsukishiro had already walked right past and moved in front
of me.
dialogues.text:
--Then, before I could even continue the "conversation",
Tsukishiro had already walked right past and moved in front
of me.

dialogues.jp: 「ありゃりゃ」
dialogues.en: "Oy oy."
dialogues.text: "Oy oy."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「今の子、知り合いか？」
dialogues.en: "You know that girl?"
dialogues.text: "You know that girl?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「知り合いっつうか……」
dialogues.en: "You could say that..."
dialogues.text: "You could say that..."

dialogues.jp:
知り合いというには、少しばかり寂しく、友達
というにはちょっと行き過ぎな気がする。
dialogues.en:
I felt a bit sad just leaving it as "knowing her", but it's
a bit too much to call her a friend right now.
dialogues.text:
I felt a bit sad just leaving it as "knowing her", but it's
a bit too much to call her a friend right now.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「結構可愛い子じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "She's really cute, isn't she?"
dialogues.text: "She's really cute, isn't she?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「まあな」
dialogues.en: "Pretty much."
dialogues.text: "Pretty much."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「でも、なんだか人形を持ってたみたいだった
　けど……」
dialogues.en: "But, why's she holding that doll with her..."
dialogues.text: "But, why's she holding that doll with her..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、月城は腹話術が得意らしいんだ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Tsukishiro has a knack for ventriloquism."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Tsukishiro has a knack for ventriloquism."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「腹話術？」
dialogues.en: "Ventriloquism?"
dialogues.text: "Ventriloquism?"

dialogues.jp:
実際に腹話術かどうかなんてわからないんだけ
ど……、まさか『人形が喋るんだよ』みたいな
ことを朝っぱらから言いたくない。
dialogues.en:
I don't even know whether it's really ventriloquism... but
it's too early to say something like "the doll can actually
talk".
dialogues.text:
I don't even know whether it's really ventriloquism... but
it's too early to say something like "the doll can actually
talk".

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「面白い子だな」
dialogues.en: "Interesting kid."
dialogues.text: "Interesting kid."

dialogues.jp: 工藤が、くすくすと笑う。
dialogues.en: Kudou giggled lightly, smiling.
dialogues.text: Kudou giggled lightly, smiling.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだよ、含みがある笑い方しやがって」
dialogues.en: "Heyy, that laugh sounded like it implied something."
dialogues.text: "Heyy, that laugh sounded like it implied something."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや、別に意味はないよ」
dialogues.en: "Nope, not a thing."
dialogues.text: "Nope, not a thing."

dialogues.jp:
工藤はそう言ったが、どう考えても、後輩に手
を出しかけている友人を笑う図、にしか見えな
いっての。
dialogues.en:
Although he said that, it's obvious he was thinking about
something involving a close friendship between senpai and
kouhai*...
dialogues.text:
Although he said that, it's obvious he was thinking about
something involving a close friendship between senpai and
kouhai*...

dialogues.jp: 別に手を出そうとしてる訳でもないんだがな。
dialogues.en: Of course the situation isn't like that.
dialogues.text: Of course the situation isn't like that.

dialogues.jp:
でも、どうしても、そういう風に見えちゃうよ
なぁ……やっぱり。
dialogues.en: But he somehow got that idea, I bet...
dialogues.text: But he somehow got that idea, I bet...

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よう、ご両人。今日もいい天気だな」
dialogues.en: "Yo, guys. The weather is superb today!"
dialogues.text: "Yo, guys. The weather is superb today!"

dialogues.jp:
突然、俺と工藤の真ん中に割り入り、二人の肩
に手を回す杉並。
dialogues.en:
Suddenly, Suginami appeared from between us, seperating our
shoulders with his hands.
dialogues.text:
Suddenly, Suginami appeared from between us, seperating our
shoulders with his hands.

dialogues.jp: 「騒がしいヤツが、現われたな……」
dialogues.en: "The noisy one has arrived..."
dialogues.text: "The noisy one has arrived..."

dialogues.jp:
一通り、挨拶を交わし、３人並んで並木道を歩
く。
dialogues.en:
After the usual morning greeting, the three of us continued
our way down the avenue.
dialogues.text:
After the usual morning greeting, the three of us continued
our way down the avenue.

dialogues.jp:
朝からくだらないことをくっちゃべりながら、
のんびり登校するのも悪くない。
dialogues.en: Along the way, we also passed by Mako and said hello.
dialogues.text: Along the way, we also passed by Mako and said hello.

dialogues.jp:
そして、その横を眞子が「おはよ」と言いなが
ら走りすぎていった。
dialogues.en:
From this morning, I started thinking that maybe going to
school on time isn't bad after all.
dialogues.text:
From this morning, I started thinking that maybe going to
school on time isn't bad after all.

dialogues.jp: たまには早起きすることにしよう。
dialogues.en: I should get up early more often.
dialogues.text: I should get up early more often.

dialogues.jp: ◆早起きした日は……◆
dialogues.en: ◆An early day is...◆
dialogues.text: ◆An early day is...◆

dialogues.jp:
たまに早起きをしてみると、ことりやら、工藤
やら、普段は登校時に会わないようなやつらに、
会う。
dialogues.en:
On a rare occasion when I woke up early, I met Kotori and
Kudou on the way to school, which I don't usually do when I
sleep till my usual time.
dialogues.text:
On a rare occasion when I woke up early, I met Kotori and
Kudou on the way to school, which I don't usually do when I
sleep till my usual time.

dialogues.jp:
珍しく、月城の方から挨拶されたりもしたが、
会話を繋げようと思った時には、すでに前方を
歩いていた。
dialogues.en:
Even more oddly, Tsukishiro greeted me, although she
immediately cut the conversation off from there.
dialogues.text:
Even more oddly, Tsukishiro greeted me, although she
immediately cut the conversation off from there.

dialogues.jp:
杉並、眞子まで現れて……なるほど、たまには
早起きもいいものかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
I also met Suginami and Mako... I see, I should learn to
wake up early more often.
dialogues.text:
I also met Suginami and Mako... I see, I should learn to
wake up early more often.
